sources.name: INPI — Registre National des Entreprises (RNE) / data.inpi.fr
sources.verdict: Verified. THE national company register: free API + SFTP bulk (JSON), daily updates; includes non-confidential annual accounts and acts/statutes since 1993. Yield: every FR legal entity. Register at data.inpi.fr for API/SFTP credentials (inpi.fr/ressources/formalites-dentreprises/acces-lapi-formalite-rne).

sources.name: INSEE — Sirene database + API Sirene
sources.verdict: Well-known open API + full monthly stock files (SIREN/SIRET, NAF codes, addresses) under Licence Ouverte; canonical identifier spine for all FR entities. Not re-fetched this session but long-established.

sources.name: Annuaire des Entreprises + API Recherche d'entreprises
sources.verdict: Verified. Government aggregator over Sirene+RNE+BODACC with a free, keyless search API (annuaire-entreprises.data.gouv.fr/donnees/api-entreprises); best single lookup route.

sources.name: Infogreffe (commercial court registries RCS)
sources.verdict: Verified alive. Company search + filings/KBIS; many documents paid, but search index is public and it is one leg of the official PPLE triad. Use RNE/Sirene for bulk; Infogreffe for court-registry documents.

sources.name: Data Infogreffe (open data portal)
sources.verdict: Opendatasoft portal with registrations/radiations/accounts datasets and API. URL not re-fetched this session — verify before wiring; known-real portal.

sources.name: data.gouv.fr (national open-data hub)
sources.verdict: Verified. Hub hosting the AMF SGP list, PSAN whitelist, BODACC/BALO/BOAMP APIs, Sirene, DECP procurement — one account, many machine routes.

sources.name: AMF — Base GECO (management companies + funds register)
sources.verdict: Verified. ~667 AIFM/UCITS management companies (SGP) with agrément scope, CSV export; the core GP register for France. Already partially harvested per brief — GECO also covers funds (OPC) beyond the SGP list.

sources.name: AMF — Liste des SGP agréées (data.gouv.fr dataset)
sources.verdict: Verified. Clean CSV of all AMF-approved portfolio management companies with agrément number, legal form, website — easiest bulk route to the FR GP universe.

sources.name: AMF — PSAN/CASP whitelist (crypto, MiCA)
sources.verdict: Verified. Official whitelist of digital-asset service providers; since 1 Jul 2026 only MiCA CASP/PSCA licensees may serve FR clients — AMF publishes the register, dataset mirrors it.

sources.name: info-financiere.gouv.fr (OAM — regulated information storage)
sources.verdict: Verified. France's centralized storage of listed-company regulated disclosures (Transparency Directive), open API + FTPS bulk via DILA — prospectuses, annual reports, major-holding notices.

sources.name: REGAFI — unified register of financial agents and insurers (ACPR)
sources.verdict: Verified. Since 1 Jul 2026 REGAFI+REFASSU merged into one daily-updated public register of all ACPR-authorized banks, investment firms, payment/e-money institutions AND insurance organisms. Search UI + downloadable lists (incl. securitization funds); no confirmed bulk dump — scrape politely or use ACPR PDF/CSV lists.

sources.name: ACPR — registers and lists page (Banque de France)
sources.verdict: Verified. ACPR (prudential regulator = banking + insurance/pension side) publishes downloadable lists: credit institutions, finance companies, insurers/mutuelles (the LP feeder population), systemic institutions.

sources.name: Banque de France — Webstat open data API
sources.verdict: Verified. 35-40k statistical series via developer.webstat.banque-france.fr (free key): credit, funds, securitization, corporate finance aggregates. Context/series data, not an entity register (FIBEN is not public).

sources.name: ORIAS — single register of insurance/banking/finance intermediaries
sources.verdict: Verified real. Registers IAS/IOBSP/CIF (financial investment advisers) — the distribution layer. Search-only UI; no open-data export found — mid yield, entity verification use.

sources.name: BODACC — official bulletin of civil & commercial announcements (open data)
sources.verdict: Verified. Free DILA API (Opendatasoft v2.1) covering incorporations, sales, mergers, and ALL insolvency proceedings (procédures collectives) — the highest-yield event stream in France; Licence Ouverte 2.0.

sources.name: BALO — bulletin of mandatory legal announcements (open data API)
sources.verdict: Verified. DILA API, data published Mon/Wed/Fri: fund notices, AGM convocations, annual accounts of issuers and financial institutions — good for fund-vehicle and issuer events.

sources.name: DILA bulk open data (echanges.dila.gouv.fr)
sources.verdict: Known DILA bulk FTP/HTTP repository for BODACC/BALO/JORF archives. Not re-fetched this session — verify path before wiring; the per-bulletin APIs above are the safer route.

sources.name: Actulégales — legal announcements from authorized newspapers (JAL)
sources.verdict: Verified. 16M+ legal announcements from ~600 authorized journals since 2010, free access; complements BODACC for pre-RCS events (constitutions, capital changes).

sources.name: PPLE — portal of legal publicity of enterprises
sources.verdict: Verified. Official GIP portal federating actulegales.fr + bodacc.fr + infogreffe.fr; use as cross-check/entry point rather than a data source itself.

sources.name: CNAJMJ — directory of judicial administrators & mandataires (insolvency practitioners)
sources.verdict: Verified. Official roll of ~170 administrateurs + ~330 mandataires judiciaires across ~270 firms, filterable by region/profession — the FR insolvency-practitioner population for the Private Debt service graph.

sources.name: BOAMP — official public procurement bulletin (open data API)
sources.verdict: Verified. Free DILA API + raw XML flow of all above-threshold tenders and awards — infrastructure/concession deal signals and EPC-contractor discovery.

sources.name: Euronext Paris — issuer and equity lists
sources.verdict: Verified. Full listed-equity tables (Euronext Paris + Growth + Access) on live.euronext.com; separate issuer-list download at euronext.com/en/media/5107/download. Tables render via JS but back onto fetchable endpoints — test the CSV export.

sources.name: France Invest — members directory (PE/VC/infra/debt association)
sources.verdict: Verified. 650+ members incl. 470+ fund managers, searchable by strategy/ticket/sector, plus associate members (advisors — service graph). Cross-reference against AMF SGP list for classification.

sources.name: AFG — Association Française de la Gestion financière
sources.verdict: Real association of FR asset managers (incl. private-markets committee); publishes industry stats and member info. Not fetched this session — verify member-directory depth.

sources.name: ASPIM — association of real-estate fund managers (SCPI/OPCI)
sources.verdict: Real; the SCPI/OPCI (unlisted real-estate vehicle) association with member list + quarterly collection stats — key Real Assets population. URL not fetched this session.

sources.name: AF2i — French association of institutional investors
sources.verdict: Real; the LP-side association (insurers, pension institutions, corporates) — member list maps the French LP universe. Not fetched this session.

sources.name: FBF — Fédération Bancaire Française
sources.verdict: Real banking association; member banks + positions. Low incremental yield vs REGAFI but useful for classification. Not fetched this session.

sources.name: ASF — Association française des Sociétés Financières (leasing/factoring/specialty finance)
sources.verdict: Real; covers leasing, factoring, sureties, consumer credit — the specialty-finance population for Private Debt. Member directory exists; not fetched this session.

sources.name: France Assureurs — insurance association
sources.verdict: Real; insurer members = major French LPs; publishes asset-allocation stats. Not fetched this session.

sources.name: France FinTech — fintech association directory
sources.verdict: Real; startup/fintech member map incl. tokenization/RWA players (Niche Alts). Not fetched this session.

sources.name: Bpifrance (national development/investment bank)
sources.verdict: Real. France's DFI and largest LP/direct investor; press releases and fund-of-funds commitments are high-value signals. Main site fetchable; its media arm blocks bots (see Big Média entry).

sources.name: Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations (CDC group)
sources.verdict: Real; sovereign investor (also parent of Banque des Territoires, CDC Croissance) and EU ETS national administrator. Press/portfolio pages; not fetched this session.

sources.name: Business France (investment promotion agency)
sources.verdict: Real; FDI promotion, annual foreign-investment barometer — signal source more than register. Not fetched this session.

sources.name: APE — Agence des participations de l'État (state shareholding agency)
sources.verdict: Real; annual report lists the full state portfolio (~85 companies) — the privatization/state-asset map. Exact URL path not re-verified this session; reachable from economie.gouv.fr.

sources.name: SERINGAS — French EU ETS registry desk (Caisse des Dépôts)
sources.verdict: Verified via search: CDC is France's national administrator of the Union Registry for GHG quotas. Portal is account-holder-oriented; use EUTL (below) for public data.

sources.name: EUTL — EU Transaction Log, French accounts (carbon)
sources.verdict: Public EU-level database of all FR ETS account holders, installations and compliance data; bulk downloadable. Standard route for carbon-market entities; not re-fetched this session.

sources.name: Label Bas-Carbone (French domestic carbon-credit standard, Ministry of Ecology)
sources.verdict: Real ministry-run domestic offset standard with a public project registry — Niche Alts (carbon) developer/buyer discovery. Exact registry URL not verified this session.

sources.name: RICS — Find a Member (France chapter)
sources.verdict: Real global directory covering RICS-accredited valuers in France; search UI is JS-heavy and paginated — low-volume manual/assisted harvest only.

sources.name: CNB — national bar council lawyer directory
sources.verdict: Real; official annuaire des avocats (annuaireavocats.cnb.avocat.fr) covers all FR lawyers — filter to business-law firms for the service graph. Directory subdomain not fetched this session.

sources.name: PLACE — state procurement platform (marches-publics.gouv.fr)
sources.verdict: Real; state tender platform complementing BOAMP. Prefer BOAMP API + DECP data for machine access. Not fetched this session.

sources.name: data.economie.gouv.fr — Ministry of Economy open data (incl. DECP procurement)
sources.verdict: Verified via search (Opendatasoft API console live). Hosts DECP (essential public-procurement contract data) and ministry finance datasets — award-level data on contractors/concessionaires.

sources.name: ERAFP — public-service additional pension scheme
sources.verdict: Real; €40bn+ pension investor publishing manager-selection tenders (incl. unlisted mandates) — direct LP signal. Domain rafp.fr not re-verified this session.

sources.name: FRR — Fonds de Réserve pour les Retraites
sources.verdict: Real sovereign pension-reserve fund; publishes RFPs/mandate awards for asset managers incl. private assets. Not fetched this session.

sources.name: Agirc-Arrco — complementary pension federation
sources.verdict: Real; largest FR complementary pension system whose member institutions are LPs; institutional publications only — low machine yield, keep for LP mapping.

sources.name: Les Echos (business daily)
sources.verdict: Top FR business daily; RSS feeds exist under services.lesechos.fr/rss/*.xml (markets feed verified via search; hunt sibling feeds for finance/PE sections). Paywalled full text — headline+link use only.

sources.name: Les Echos Capital Finance (PE/M&A vertical)
sources.verdict: Real; the historic French PE trade letter (deals, funds, nominations). Subscription; no public RSS found — headline monitoring only.

sources.name: L'AGEFI (agefi.fr, incl. NewsManagers asset-management wire)
sources.verdict: Core FR institutional-finance media (asset management, PE, institutional investors; owns NewsManagers). Site refuses bot fetches; RSS feeds referenced by third-party directories but direct feed URLs unverified.

sources.name: CFNEWS (Corporate Finance News)
sources.verdict: Verified rich RSS set at cfnews.net/rss/list: 18 feeds incl. /rss/feed/lbo, /capital-innovation, /capital-developpement, /retournement, /nominations — the single best FR deal-signal feed family. Respect reproduction policy (headline+link).

sources.name: CFNEWS IMMO (commercial real estate finance)
sources.verdict: Verified feed-list page exists; sister publication for FR real-estate deals/funds — Real Assets signal stream.

sources.name: Maddyness (startup/VC media)
sources.verdict: Feed fetched and verified valid (WordPress RSS, active Aug 2026): FR startup funding rounds and French Tech coverage.

sources.name: FrenchWeb / FW Média
sources.verdict: Feed fetched and verified valid, hourly updates: FR/EU tech funding and scale-up coverage.

sources.name: Sifted (FT-backed, strong France coverage)
sources.verdict: Feed fetched and verified valid RSS 2.0; European VC/startup coverage incl. French rounds and funds.

sources.name: La Tribune (business daily)
sources.verdict: Real major business daily; direct fetch blocked by bot protection. Legacy RSS infrastructure (ged.latribune.fr/data/rss) referenced but unverified — treat as headline-scrape-with-care.

sources.name: BFM Business
sources.verdict: Real; leading business broadcaster with economy/markets sections. RSS pattern (bfmtv.com/rss/economie/) plausible but unverified this session.

sources.name: Option Finance (corporate-finance weekly, incl. La Tribune de l'Assurance)
sources.verdict: Real; corporate finance/treasury/asset management trade press. Subscription model; no RSS found — newsletter/headline monitoring.

sources.name: Business Immo (real-estate trade press)
sources.verdict: Real; the FR commercial-real-estate trade daily. Fetch returned 403 (bot-blocked); /feed also 403 — needs polite crawler or newsletter route.

sources.name: L'Usine Nouvelle (industry)
sources.verdict: Real industrial/manufacturing daily — factory investments, energy, EPC signals. RSS existence not verified this session.

sources.name: GreenUnivers (energy-transition finance)
sources.verdict: Feed fetched and verified valid RSS 2.0: renewables M&A, fund raises, infra deals (e.g. Idex sale, TotalEnergies/KKR) — prime Real Assets/Transition signal source.

sources.name: H24 Finance (asset-management news)
sources.verdict: Real FR asset-management/CGP news portal (fund launches, SGP moves). Not fetched this session; no RSS confirmed.

sources.name: Décideurs Magazine / Leaders League
sources.verdict: Real; rankings and news across PE, restructuring, law firms — useful for service-graph mapping (rankings are directories of advisors). Not fetched this session.

sources.name: IEIF — Institut de l'Épargne Immobilière et Foncière
sources.verdict: Real real-estate investment research institute (SCPI/OPCI stats, market studies) — context source for Real Assets. Not fetched this session.

sources.name: AMF — press releases & sanctions RSS
sources.verdict: Verified feed URLs via search: /fr/flux-rss/display/23 (press+sanctions), /25 (publications), /30 (news), /21 (all). Sanctions and agrément news = high-grade signals.

sources.name: Banque de France — press & publications
sources.verdict: Real; central-bank press releases, financial-stability reports. RSS not confirmed this session; page structure fetchable.

sources.name: Ministry of Economy press room (Bercy)
sources.verdict: Real government press room: state-asset moves, financial-sector policy. Not fetched this session.

sources.name: DG Trésor — publications
sources.verdict: Real; Treasury directorate publications (financial-sector policy, ORIAS supervision). Context source. Not fetched this session.

sources.name: Bpifrance Big Média + press releases
sources.verdict: Real Bpifrance media arm (fund commitments, ecosystem news); /feed returned 403 — bot-blocked, use presse.bpifrance.fr releases via polite crawl.

sources.name: Euronext — company press releases / market news
sources.verdict: Issuer press-release flow for Paris-listed companies; complements info-financiere.gouv.fr API (which is the better machine route). Exact path not re-verified this session.

sources.name: Le Monde — Économie
sources.verdict: Real; general-interest daily with strong economy desk. Direct fetch blocked this session; historical RSS pattern (/economie/rss_full.xml) unverified — treat cautiously.

sources.name: Challenges (business weekly)
sources.verdict: Real business weekly (deals, fortunes, company coverage). RSS not verified this session.

sources.name: Boursorama (markets portal)
sources.verdict: Real; highest-traffic FR markets portal, aggregates newswires and issuer releases. Aggregator — prefer original sources for provenance; not fetched this session.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Strong on French GPs, funds, performance and LP commitments (Bpifrance, insurers, ERAFP/FRR mandates); weaker on deal-level and mid-market detail.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: AMF GECO/SGP register (fund-manager universe), France Invest activity & performance reports, BALO fund notices, LP annual reports (ERAFP, FRR, insurers), press releases — all directly accessible to us.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Good FR PE/VC deal and valuation coverage, cap tables inferred from filings; strong advisor mapping.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: INPI RNE filings and annual accounts (open API/SFTP), BODACC events (open API), Euronext/AMF regulated disclosures via info-financiere.gouv.fr, company press releases.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Powers the official La French Tech ecosystem map — deepest FR startup/VC round coverage of the globals.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: INSEE Sirene + INPI RNE open data for firmographics, press/startup-media (Maddyness, FrenchWeb, Sifted class), self-reported profiles, France Invest/EDF-style association stats.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Broad but shallow FR coverage; rounds from press and self-report, patchy on non-tech alternatives.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Press releases and startup media, Sirene-derived registry data via aggregators — nothing we cannot get from Sirene + RSS feeds directly.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: THE French deal reference: near-exhaustive mid-market M&A/LBO/venture and real-estate deal tables, advisor league tables, nominations; subscription DB.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Own journalism plus BODACC/greffe filings, actulegales JAL announcements, advisor deal submissions and press releases; its free RSS layer (18 feeds) is itself a usable public signal source for us.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Free full-text French company intelligence (filings, accounts, beneficial-owner history where public); has become the default FR company lookup.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Built ENTIRELY on public open data — INPI RNE API/SFTP, BODACC open data, BALO, Infogreffe documents, Sirene — the clearest proof-of-route: everything Pappers shows, we can ingest from the same open endpoints at $0.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Mass-market company lookups, financials, legal events; ad/freemium model.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Sirene, RCS/Infogreffe, BODACC — same open stack as Pappers.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Credit risk, payment behavior, firmographics for the full FR company universe; sell scores not intelligence.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Greffes/Infogreffe filings, BODACC, Sirene, annual accounts from RNE; their proprietary layer (payment data) is not public — the registry layer underneath is.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Sector research studies (incl. asset management, real estate, NPL-adjacent sectors); analysis product, not entity data.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: INSEE statistics, Banque de France/Webstat series, annual accounts from RNE — context sources we already catalog.

searchedButAbsent: Searched but not found or excluded to keep the count honest: (1) direct AGEFI RSS feed URLs — the site blocks bot fetches and only third-party feed directories attest feeds exist, so no rssUrl recorded; (2) any ORIAS bulk/open-data export — only the per-record search UI; (3) a confirmed full bulk dump of the merged REGAFI register — daily search UI plus ACPR downloadable lists only; (4) a separate French fund-administrator/depositary licensee register — that population lives inside REGAFI (credit institutions/depositaries) and AMF lists, no standalone roll; (5) Private Equity Magazine and L'Informé — both real publications but I could not confirm their exact domains this session, so they were excluded rather than guessed; (6) a downloadable RICS France valuer roster — only the JS-heavy global Find-a-Member UI; (7) verified RSS for La Tribune, Le Monde Économie, Business Immo, BFM Business, Usine Nouvelle — sites bot-blocked or feeds unconfirmed, marked accordingly rather than invented; (8) a public UBO (bénéficiaires effectifs) feed — INPI RBE access is restricted post-2022 CJEU ruling, consistent with the project's no-open-UBO assumption.
